regions.finding: Generic stereodivergent overview: Rh gives syn and Pd gives anti tetrahydropyrimidinones; it is not counted as a separate concrete experiment from the detailed methods.
Prose identifies Table 1 entries 1 and 2: 85% combined yield/1:1 and 99%/20:1 anti:syn, respectively; detailed row facts are linked to the page-2 table.

unresolved: Graphical abstract does not give concrete substrate identities, charges, time, temperature, workup or purification.
Absolute configurations are not assigned; syn/anti are relative descriptors.

regions.region: upper-left prior-work comparison and 'This work' diagram
regions.finding: Three cited literature transformations (Menche 2010, White 2013, Hara 2015) were classified as literature_example records; the current-work drawing is represented by generic Pd/Rh method records.

Seven separate optimization experiments were extracted row-by-row, including catalyst/additive loadings, temperature, 16 h, isolated yield, crude-1H-NMR anti:syn ratio, and the increased Rh/DPEphos loading in entry 7.
Fourteen Pd anti-selective substrate-scope experiments were extracted individually with common conditions, isolated yields and anti:syn d.r. values.

regions.region: lower-right prose continuing Rh scope and introducing Scheme 3
regions.finding: Prose cross-references the Rh scope and says follow-up reactions were performed on 3a; this conflicts with the Scheme 3 central label 2a on page 3 and is explicitly retained as a source conflict.

unresolved: The main article does not give substrate charges, scale, workup or purification for the scope entries; the advertised SI was not supplied.
Concrete structures are machine-transcribed candidates and remain needs_review.
Scheme 3 starting-material label conflict (2a in scheme versus 3a in prose) is unresolved.

regions.finding: Fourteen Rh syn-selective scope experiments were extracted separately with printed common conditions, isolated yields and crude-1H-NMR syn:anti d.r. values.

Six arrows were recorded as separate derivatization experiments. The two-stage a,b sequence retains both stages and the 72% overall two-step yield; ozonolysis/reductive workup retains separate -78 °C/10 min and rt/1 h stages.
Two controls were separated: 3a under Pd conditions gives anti-2a quantitatively at d.r. 96:4, while 2a under Rh conditions shows no reaction/no d.r. change.

regions.region: Scheme 5 lower-right and preceding mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Intermediates A-C and arrows were recorded as one proposed_mechanism, not as isolated experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 3 centre is labelled 2a, whereas page-2 prose says 3a; no silent correction was made.
Yield measurement basis is not stated for Scheme 3 products 4-7 or the quantitative Scheme 4 product; these remain null/missing.
Absolute configurations of the relative syn/anti products are not assigned.
Proposed intermediates A-C are not isolated or independently verified.

regions.finding: Author interpretation of Rh inner-sphere formation of kinetic syn-3a and Pd outer-sphere formation/equilibration to thermodynamic anti-2a; linked to the Scheme 5 proposed-mechanism record.
The article advertises SI containing synthetic procedures, analytical data and computational data, but no SI file was explicitly supplied or associated; no SI facts were imported.
No additional synthesis arrow, optimization row, reaction table or standalone characterization dataset was present.

unresolved: Mechanistic proposal is not experimental proof.
SI association remains unestablished despite the availability notice.

regions.finding: Bibliography only. Reference citations were not converted into current-paper experiments, and no mass-spectrum, molecular-weight or fragment table was present.
